title: Audit the P104 substitution and prove its repair is necessary
body:
**Independent rational audit:** the first new paid edit in [PR #7774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7774) preserves all 1,264 public output rows. Its source slope and repair coefficient are uniquely `(4, 1)` in the stated two-parameter family. An explicit input separates the required repair from all 907 retained banks at its receiving chart, so those fixed banks cannot reconstruct it for free. **No new kappa** or full supplier admission is claimed.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/PROOF.md), [residual and separation certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/CREDITS.md). This answers the [requested 99771/104247 review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19724778) at exact source head `22fff773f897e70a2c346d09de62515fadb1c445`.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| First edit | Remove ranks 2 and 3; add rank-5 leg 53; 5,712 → 5,711 paid positions |
| Full rational operator | All 1,264 input/output rows agree; 23,563,352 coefficient products |
| Parameter residual | 69 affected outputs; a two-by-two minor has determinant -4 |
| Fixed receiving banks | Rank 907; the repair raises rank to 908; a 62-input separator gives repair value -1/16 |
| Complete submitted word | Rebuilt final digest; omitting leg 53 changes output 19 by -8 on input 1 |

For removed source value `x`, the full error is `x*((4-lambda)*a + (rho-1)*b)`. Output roles 186 and 38 have response pairs `(-1/4,0)` and `(2,16)`. Thus no change of repair coefficient can hide a wrong source slope. The bank separator annihilates every retained bank at chart 127, including any bank too late for a particular output. The obstruction therefore also applies to each causal subset. It proves a required paid delivery with those other bank functions fixed; it does not prove global rank-5 cost optimality.

Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-first-relay-repair
```

Both modes report:

```text
PASS_P104_FIRST_RELAY_REPAIR 1264 owners 69 affected outputs 907 separated banks
```

The line also reports elapsed seconds. Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. The checker authenticates 38 retained files, uses the unchanged source constructors, and checks every changed coefficient, acyclic same-chart access and strict paid nesting. Four wrong parameter pairs and a wrong source chart fail their required identities. A compensation that hides the error at output 38 still fails at output 186. Hosted CI is pending; it is not scientific evidence yet.

Clear1nsight (@Clear1nsight) supplied the [joint source and ordered paid edits](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22fff773f897e70a2c346d09de62515fadb1c445/research/p104-closed-supplier-relays/PAID-EDITS.json), [bridge](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/22fff773f897e70a2c346d09de62515fadb1c445/research/p104-closed-supplier-relays/rebase_pr7767.py) and [review request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19724778). The unchanged parent differential constructors come from [PR #7767](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7767)'s [verifier](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94/handoffs/p104-paid-relays/verify.py). Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied the [released graph](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6b0b2f7de0f068834264fc50b75a39a72c52ea22/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/GRAPH.json.gz) and [parent credit chain](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/CREDITS.md). The retained notices preserve DreamingOfClouds, SYLforge, Rohan Arun, Douglas Colkitt, Jerry Chen (CubeJerry) and earlier contributors' credit. Their physical checks are not rerun here.

This is a source-aware independent implementation, not blind or independent human acceptance. Signed Pauli realization, physical integer execution, caller assembly, ordinary services, directed prices and compiler closure were not replayed. No selected cold replay, Lean or Docker ran. All five framework assumptions remain. A broader optional quotient cost search was stopped without a result. The newer supplier in [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776) is separate; this certificate does not automatically transfer to it.
